subject: Service Access Reconciliation and Owner Snapback — MedallionHealth SIG intake
messages:
From: Claudia Reyes <claudia@medallionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medallionhealth.com
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service access reconciliation — initial intake

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking our SIG intake. We're in the middle of a SOC 2 readiness push and need a compact package of artifacts to validate your access controls for the product tenant that integrates with our SSO. Specifically, the auditor asked for:

- A recent SCIM delta export (last 30 days) showing user provisioning events by timestamp
- A sample SAML assertion (for an engineer account) with Attribute statements included
- A mapping of roles to Redwood service accounts and owners (owner contact)

Do you have an owner reconciliation plan and a short timeline for delivering these? We can accept csv / txt stubs; we'll redact where needed.

Appreciate a snapshot by end of week if possible.

Thanks,
Claudia
Security Programs, Medallion Health

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claudia Reyes <claudia@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service access reconciliation — initial intake

Claudia — thanks for the clear ask. Looping Jordan (security eng) and Laura (Customer Success) to coordinate artifacts and the owner reconciliation.

Short plan:
- Jordan will extract a SCIM delta sample (anonymized) and a representative SAML assertion.
- Laura will lead the owner mapping and provide a workback for owner confirmations / snapback.
- We'll deliver a redacted bundle and a one-page summary for your auditor.

Jordan / Laura: can you confirm ETA? Jordan — we should include SCIM events for provisioning, deprovisioning, and role changes (include timestamps and source). Also, please add a note if service accounts are excluded and how they're tracked.

I'll prepare a rolling access snapshot to accompany the artifacts.

Best,
Markus
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service access reconciliation — initial intake

On Sun, Mar 2, 2025 at 09:05 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Jordan / Laura: can you confirm ETA? Jordan — we should include SCIM events for provisioning, deprovisioning, and role changes (include timestamps and source). Also, please add a note if service accounts are excluded and how they're tracked.

Will do. Quick status: I pulled a 30-day SCIM delta from our provisioning pipeline (anonymized). It contains: user_email_hash, event_type, timestamp, source (okta/provisioner), role_before, role_after. I will scrub identifiable emails and deliver medallion_scim_delta_sample.csv.

SAML: attaching a redacted saml_assertion_example.txt that strips NameID and replaces with <REDACTED>. It includes attribute mappings (email, groups, role).

Service accounts: excluded from the SCIM export; they live in a separate vault. I'll add a small table summarizing where service accounts are registered and their owners (owner = team alias or person).

ETA: I can have the CSV and SAML sample ready by Mon 3/3 noon PT. Will also put a short README explaining fields.

-Jordan
Security Engineer

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claudia Reyes <claudia@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Mar 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service access reconciliation — initial intake

Claudia — following up with artifacts and next steps. Attached: medallion_scim_delta_sample.csv (anonymized), saml_assertion_example.txt (redacted), and owner_snapback_workback.xlsx (workback and owner list).

High level notes:
- SCIM delta includes provisioning, deprovisioning, and role changes with source column identifying "okta" or "api". Rows with direct HR syncs are flagged.
- SAML assertion is a single successful login assertion for an engineer account; attributes included: email (redacted), groups, role, tenant_id. Time zone normalized to UTC.
- Owner snapback: Laura's sheet contains owners for application roles and suggested confirmation cadence. Where owners are unknown, we've marked as TBD and recommended owner rotation to the platform team.

Next steps for Medallion:
1) Laura will run owner confirmation emails using the owner list (expected 5 business days).
2) Once owners confirm, we'll provide a final mapping and an exported role-to-permission matrix.
3) If the auditor needs a signed attestation, we can provide a short statement of collection methodology.

Please confirm receipt. If you want an encrypted transfer or a DocuSign attestation, note that in reply.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Claudia Reyes <claudia@medallionhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medallionhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Mar 2025 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Service access reconciliation — initial intake

Thanks, Markus — received and shared with our audit lead. The CSV and SAML sample look good for preliminary review. A few quick items:

- Can Laura's owner confirmation include an explicit "last reviewed" column for each owner? That helps our control narrative.
- Please include an entry for any delegated admin roles (we saw a few role change events that referenced "delegated_admin").
- We'll accept the attestation PDF; please route via our secure intake portal (link below) or DocuSign if more convenient.

Portal link: https://portal.medallionhealth.com/sig-intake/HS-12345

If Laura can run the confirmations this week, we should be able to close this item in our SIG intake next week. I'll follow up if the auditor requests anything more specific.

-Claudia
Security Programs, Medallion Health
